mentions.name: Arcane Scholar
mentions.description: A local-first application for tabletop RPG needs: create and manage characters, classes, spells, and more, then package them up to share with your table. The first pass focuses on a streamlined character creator for a single game (Nimble RPG, after switching from the 5.5e SRD), with character sheets and persistent object storage next. Built with SvelteKit.
mentions.problem: Existing TTRPG tools are slow-loading, subscription-based, require buying the digital book again on every platform, and won't let you use the physical book from your shelf; the 5.5e SRD also contained lots of text with little actual content and rules that are hard to build software for.
mentions.audience: Tabletop RPG players sharing characters and content with their table
